These are documented policy choices, not merely rhetoric, although implementation depended on coalition and alliance institutions. batch_notes: The comparative meter was anchored with Russia as the low case, China and Iran as severe coercive cases, Germany, Japan, Indonesia, and Mexico as stronger diplomacy and lawful-security cases, and mixed cases including Ethiopia, Turkey, and the DRC.
Country-level UCDP and SIPRI priors were used only as contextual exposure and capacity information, not as automatic ruler conduct or severity.
No client-matrix information, web search, memory-derived facts, or discovery-only evidence was used.
Complaint or report volume was not treated as severity, and no blanket democracy or autocracy correction was applied.
